title: Unraveling the Structural Changes in the DNA-Binding Region of Tumor Protein p53 (TP53) upon Hotspot Mutation p53 Arg248 by Comparative Computational Approach.
authors: Balasundaram, Ambritha; Doss, C George Priya
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算预测与分子动力学模拟系统研究p53肿瘤蛋白热点突变R248对DNA结合域结构稳定性及结合亲和力的影响，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法上采用MD与MM-PBSA等物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The vital tissue homeostasis regulator p53 forms a tetramer when it binds to DNA and regulates the genes that mediate essential biological processes such as cell-cycle arrest, senescence, DNA repair, and apoptosis. Missense mutations in the core DNA-binding domain (109-292) simultaneously cause the loss of p53 tumor suppressor function and accumulation of the mutant p53 proteins that are carcinogenic. The most common p53 hotspot mutation at codon 248 in the DNA-binding region, where arginine (R) is substituted by tryptophan (W), glycine (G), leucine (L), proline (P), and glutamine (Q), is reported in various cancers. However, it is unclear how the p53 Arg248 mutation with distinct amino acid substitution affects the structure, function, and DNA binding affinity. Here, we characterized the pathogenicity and protein stability of p53 hotspot mutations at codon 248 using computational tools PredictSNP, Align GVGD, HOPE, ConSurf, and iStable. We found R248W, R248G, and R248P mutations highly deleterious and destabilizing. Further, we subjected all five R248 mutant-p53-DNA and wt-p53-DNA complexes to molecular dynamics simulation to investigate the structural stability and DNA binding affinity. From the MD simulation analysis, we observed increased RMSD, RMSF, and Rg values and decreased protein-DNA intermolecular hydrogen bonds in the R248-p53-DNA than the wt-p53-DNA complexes. Likewise, due to high SASA values, we observed the shrinkage of proteins in R248W, R248G, and R248P mutant-p53-DNA complexes. Compared to other mutant p53-DNA complexes, the R248W, R248G, and R248P mutant-p53-DNA complexes showed more structural alteration. MM-PBSA analysis showed decreased binding energies with DNA in all five R248-p53-DNA mutants than the wt-p53-DNA complexes. Henceforth, we conclude that the amino acid substitution of Arginine with the other five amino acids at codon 248 reduces the p53 protein's affinity for DNA and may disrupt cell division, resulting in a gain of p53 function. The proposed study influences the development of rationally designed molecular-targeted treatments that improve p53-based therapeutic outcomes in cancer.
abstract_zh: 重要的组织稳态调节因子p53在与DNA结合时形成四聚体，并调控介导细胞周期阻滞、衰老、DNA修复和凋亡等基本生物过程的基因。核心DNA结合域（109-292）的错义突变同时导致p53肿瘤抑制功能丧失和致癌性突变p53蛋白的积累。在DNA结合区域第248密码子处最常见的p53热点突变，其中精氨酸（R）被色氨酸（W）、甘氨酸（G）、亮氨酸（L）、脯氨酸（P）和谷氨酰胺（Q）替代，已在多种癌症中报道。然而，具有不同氨基酸替代的p53 Arg248突变如何影响结构、功能和DNA结合亲和力尚不清楚。在此，我们使用计算工具PredictSNP、Align GVGD、HOPE、ConSurf和iStable表征了第248密码子处p53热点突变的致病性和蛋白质稳定性。我们发现R248W、R248G和R248P突变具有高度有害性和去稳定性。进一步，我们将所有五种R248突变p53-DNA和野生型p53-DNA复合物进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，以研究结构稳定性和DNA结合亲和力。从MD模拟分析中，我们观察到与wt-p53-DNA复合物相比，R248-p53-DNA复合物中RMSD、RMSF和Rg值增加，蛋白质-DNA分子间氢键减少。同样，由于高SASA值，我们观察到R248W、R248G和R248P突变p53-DNA复合物中蛋白质收缩。与其他突变p53-DNA复合物相比，R248W、R248G和R248P突变p53-DNA复合物表现出更多的结构改变。MM-PBSA分析显示，与wt-p53-DNA复合物相比，所有五种R248-p53-DNA突变体与DNA的结合能均降低。因此，我们得出结论，第248密码子处精氨酸被其他五种氨基酸替代会降低p53蛋白对DNA的亲和力，并可能破坏细胞分裂，导致p53功能获得。本研究影响合理设计的分子靶向治疗的发展，以改善癌症中基于p53的治疗结果。
